name: Sharu
source:
Childhood best friends with Naala and Salaana. Sharu is strong-willed, and doesn't let anything illogical or unjust slide. Those traits bring out a different side of her when they're taken to Nasura...

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel12]official website profile[/URL].]
